purpose: Candidate two-slot TCN residual strategy for BTC 5m binary markets. Locked to prevent parameter drift before shadow/live parity validation.

execution_assumptions.entry_scope: one entry per market per strategy_id

strategies.side_selection: buy side with higher EV, UP if ev_up >= ev_down else DOWN
buy side with higher EV, UP if ev_up >= ev_down else DOWN

market_only_same_rules.note: With beta=0, the same EV thresholds produce no trades. The trade set is created by the TCN residual, not by raw market-implied probability alone.

discovery_metrics_reference.note: Discovery report used the earlier saved late-trade artifact. Canonical clean re-run should be preferred for implementation.

validation_requirements_before_live: Run live shadow with per-strategy_id logging.
Allow one entry per market per strategy_id, not global one-entry-per-market.
Enforce shared max exposure cap per market because both strategies can enter the same market.
Log raw features, p_market, tcn_delta, p_strategy, EV, side, quote, delayed fill quote, source ages, and strategy_id for every candidate decision.
Do not consider this lock live-approved until source-time replay and shadow parity pass.
known_caveats: The UTC 02-13 filter was discovered after inspecting test-period hourly PnL, so anti-snooping validation is still required.
The TCN was trained primarily with TTC 15-90 loss, while the early strategy uses TTC 75-120; retrain/evaluate a TTC 15-120 or 15-150 model before treating the early slot as final.
The global TCN probability metrics are not better than market baseline; the edge hypothesis is local trade selection from residual deltas.
Dataset coverage is incomplete: 32 available test days over 50 calendar days.
